title: EV charging for offices and workplaces | VOOL
description: Charging for employees, company cars and visitors on the connection you have. Private charging is paid by the employee, company cars are reported separately.

sections.title: Charging at work, without the company paying for private kilometres
sections.lead: Employees pay for their own charging. Company cars are reported separately. The building’s connection stays as it is.
sections.alt: Office car park with VOOL chargers

items.title: No grid upgrade
items.text: VOOL LMC shares the spare capacity of the building between the cars, so more chargers fit on the same main fuse.

items.title: Three groups, three prices
items.text: Company cars, employees and visitors each get their own price and access rights.

items.title: No invoicing work
items.text: VOOL charges employees for private charging and pays the company monthly.

items.title: Reports for accounting
items.text: Energy and cost per car and per user, sent on a schedule.

items.title: Open to visitors
items.text: Make some chargers public in office hours or after them, with payment by QR code.

items.title: Company cars at home
items.text: Drivers who charge a company car at home can report the energy from their own VOOL charger.

sections.alt: VOOL charger beside an office entrance
sections.title: Start with a few chargers, add more when cars arrive
sections.text: Build the cabling and load management once. Each new charger then takes minutes to add, and the LMC shares the capacity again.
points: One LMC Pro manages more than 100 chargers
Load management at several fuse levels
Works with other makers’ chargers over OCPP

items.title: You send the basics
items.text: Parking spaces, main fuse size and how many chargers you need now. A photo of the switchboard helps.

items.title: We size the system
items.text: VOOL works out how many chargers your connection carries with load management, and what to prepare for later.

items.title: A partner quotes and installs
items.text: VOOL does not install. A certified installation partner visits the site, quotes the work and builds it.

items.title: We set up the software
items.text: Users, prices and billing are set up in the VOOL Portal. Drivers charge with the VOOL App or an RFID card.

items.title: Support for the life of the system
items.text: Remote diagnostics, software updates and a 5-year warranty on the chargers.

items.q: Can employees pay for private charging themselves?
items.a: Yes. They pay by card in the VOOL App, VOOL invoices them and transfers the money to the company monthly.

items.q: We rent our office. Who should own the chargers?
items.a: Either the landlord or the tenant can. Access groups let one installation serve several companies in the same building.

items.q: We already have chargers from another maker.
items.a: Chargers that support OCPP 1.6 or 2.0 can be added to the VOOL Portal.

sections.title: How many chargers fit on your office’s connection?
sections.lead: Send us the parking spaces and the main fuse size.
